answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to lock a scarce token as a bond before it may submit jobs or claim rewards. If an identity is caught double-claiming or colluding, the protocol slashes that bond, so creating thousands of hollow accounts is no longer free: the attacker must tie up real capital and risks losing it. The bond need not prove a person’s identity; it raises the cost of influence, while a relic credential or lotus badge can remain only a reputation signal, not a substitute for the stake.
